prompt: A spray-painted stencil graffiti of a fox head with three eyes, the third eye open in the middle of its forehead, painted on a weathered grey concrete wall in an abandoned rail yard. The fox is drawn in bold black stencil spray paint with sharp angular woodcut-style cuts, pointed ears with small hoop earrings, and a sly knowing look; the third eye and a thin outline ring around the head are bright blood-red spray paint with drips running down the wall. The concrete has stains, cracks, faded old tags and a torn paper flyer at one edge, so the fox reads as street art left by a resistance movement. Flat overcast daylight, camera straight on to the wall, the fox centered and filling about two thirds of the frame. Desaturated grey palette with only black and red paint.
